```yaml
name: GPU Reset

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, rocm, gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.10]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup UV
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          activate-environment: iris
          ignore-empty-workdir: true
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install PyTorch ROCm
        run: |
          pip install torch==2.3.0+rocm5.6.2 -f https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm5.6/torch_stable.html

      - name: Install project dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Run all-gather tests
        run: |
          export PYTHONPATH=$PWD
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest -q tests/test_all_gather_gluon.py
```
